query: SELECT count(*) AS "rows!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'charge') AS "paid!", COALESCE(sum(amount_cents) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'charge'), 0)::bigint AS "fees!", COALESCE(sum(amount_cents) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'processing-fee'), 0)::bigint AS "stripe!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'refund') AS "refunds!", COALESCE(sum(CASE kind WHEN 'refund' THEN amount_cents WHEN 'refund-reversal' THEN -amount_cents END), 0)::bigint AS "refunded!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'dispute') AS "disputes!" FROM payments.ledger_entry WHERE job_id = ANY($1) AND recorded_at >= $2 AND recorded_at < $3 AND kind IN ('charge', 'processing-fee', 'refund', 'refund-reversal', 'dispute')
